MinTemperatureComment: Minimum temperature (Celsius) required to start a fire.
StartHourComment: The earliest and latest hour of the day (24-hour format) when firestarting is allowed.
CheckCloudsComment: If true, mod will check cloud density and brightness to determine conditions for firestarting.
CheckRainComment: If true, mod will check if its raining.
CheckWindComment: If true, mod will check wind speed and block firestarting if its too windy.
EnableNotificationsComment: Displays warning messages for failed attempts and reason.
EnableDebugLoggingComment: If true, debug logs will be enabled for troubleshooting.
